name: SfOrgValidateDeploy
description: Generates delta with sfdx-git-delta (HEAD vs HEAD~1), optional Code Analyzer on delta only (default rules or custom PMD ruleset), JWT or SFDX Auth URL org login, validate or deploy, and pipeline artifacts.
helpMarkDown: [sfdx-git-delta](https://github.com/scolladon/sfdx-git-delta) | Auth: JWT (`sf org login jwt`) or Auth URL (`sf org login sfdx-url`). Set checkout `fetchDepth: 0` so HEAD~1 exists.
author: Your Team

inputs.name: operationMode
inputs.label: Operation

options.auto: Auto (PR to target branch = validate; CI on target branch after merge = deploy)

inputs.helpMarkDown: Auto: if the pull request **targets** the configured **Target branch**, run validation; when a build runs on that **same branch** after merge (not a PR build), run deployment.

inputs.name: alias
inputs.label: Org alias
inputs.helpMarkDown: Salesforce CLI org alias used after login.

inputs.name: authMethod
inputs.label: Authentication method
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose how the pipeline authenticates to the Salesforce org. Fields below appear based on this selection.

inputs.name: orgType
inputs.label: Type of destination org (production vs sandbox)

options.sandbox: sandbox — uses https://test.salesforce.com unless Instance URL is set
options.production: production — uses https://login.salesforce.com unless Instance URL is set

inputs.helpMarkDown: Same idea as Tiago’s production/sandbox selector. Used for JWT `--instance-url` when Instance URL is blank.

inputs.name: instance_url
inputs.label: Instance URL (optional override)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. If empty, derived from **Type of destination org** (`sandbox` → test.salesforce.com, `production` → login.salesforce.com). Use a custom My Domain URL when needed.

inputs.name: jwt_key_file
inputs.label: JWT private key file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Full path to the JWT private key on the agent (for example after DownloadSecureFile: `$(jwtkey.secureFilePath)`).

inputs.name: jwt_token_path
inputs.label: JWT path override (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: If set, this path is used instead of JWT private key file path.

inputs.name: sfdx_auth_url_file
inputs.label: SFDX Auth URL file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a file that contains one line: the SFDX Auth URL (`force://...`). Often from DownloadSecureFile.

inputs.name: sfdx_auth_url
inputs.label: SFDX Auth URL (secret variable)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional alternative to a file: paste or bind a secret variable with the Auth URL. The task writes it to a temporary file for `sf org login sfdx-url`. Prefer a secure file in production.

inputs.name: sfCliVersion
inputs.label: Salesforce CLI npm version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Passed to `npm install -g @salesforce/cli@version`.

inputs.name: deltaFromRef
inputs.label: Delta from ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Git ref for sfdx-git-delta `--from` (default HEAD~1).

inputs.name: ignoreFile
inputs.label: sfdx-git-delta ignore file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional path to ignore file; if blank and `ignorefile` exists in repo root, it is used.

inputs.name: targetBranch
inputs.label: Target branch (integration branch)
inputs.helpMarkDown: The branch developers merge into. **PR validation** runs only when the PR **targets** this branch. **Deploy** runs only when the pipeline executes on this branch after merge.

inputs.name: validateTestLevel
inputs.label: Apex test level — validate (PR / dry-run)

options.RunLocalTests: RunLocalTests — all tests in the org except managed packages
options.RunAllTestsInOrg: RunAllTestsInOrg — all tests in the org
options.RunSpecifiedTests: RunSpecifiedTests — only the classes listed below

inputs.helpMarkDown: Used when the task runs **validation** (dry-run).

inputs.name: validateSpecifiedTests
inputs.label: Specified test classes (validate)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated Apex test class names for validation.

inputs.name: deployTestLevel
inputs.label: Apex test level — deploy (after merge)

options.RunLocalTests: RunLocalTests — all tests in the org except managed packages
options.RunAllTestsInOrg: RunAllTestsInOrg — all tests in the org
options.RunSpecifiedTests: RunSpecifiedTests — only the classes listed below

inputs.helpMarkDown: Used when the task runs **deployment**.

inputs.name: deploySpecifiedTests
inputs.label: Specified test classes (deploy)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated Apex test class names for deployment.

inputs.name: deployWaitTime
inputs.label: Deploy wait time (minutes)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Passed to `sf project deploy start --wait` and deploy report (minutes). Default 120.

inputs.name: ignoreWarnings
inputs.label: Ignore warnings
inputs.helpMarkDown: When true, adds `--ignore-warnings` to validate and deploy.

inputs.name: ignoreConflicts
inputs.label: Ignore conflicts (deploy only)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When true, adds `--ignore-conflicts` on **deploy** (not on dry-run validate).

inputs.name: runCodeAnalyzer
inputs.label: Run Code Analyzer on delta (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, runs Salesforce Code Analyzer only on **delta-generated** sources. Use a custom PMD ruleset below, or leave unchecked to use the default analyzer rules.

inputs.name: useCustomPmdRuleset
inputs.label: Use custom PMD ruleset
inputs.helpMarkDown: When checked, provide a PMD ruleset XML path. When unchecked, the default Code Analyzer rule selection is used.

inputs.name: pmdRulesetPath
inputs.label: PMD ruleset XML path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path in the repo (or on the agent) to your PMD ruleset `.xml`. Commit the ruleset or download it in a prior step, then select the path here.

inputs.name: codeAnalyzerRuleSelector
inputs.label: Code Analyzer rule selector (default mode)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Used only when **Use custom PMD ruleset** is off. Passed to `sf code-analyzer run --rule-selector`.

inputs.name: codeAnalyzerSeverityThreshold
inputs.label: Code Analyzer severity threshold (CLI)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Passed to `sf code-analyzer run --severity-threshold`.

inputs.name: enforceSeverityGate
inputs.label: Enforce max severity from CSV
inputs.helpMarkDown: After the run, fail the task if any CSV row has numeric Severity greater than Max allowed severity.

inputs.name: maxAllowedSeverity
inputs.label: Max allowed severity (numeric)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Block PR/task if any finding severity is **greater than** this value.

inputs.name: publishDeltaArtifact
inputs.label: Publish delta package as pipeline artifact

inputs.name: deltaArtifactName
inputs.label: Delta artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Per-pipeline name (e.g. `$(Build.DefinitionName)-Delta-Package`).

inputs.name: publishCodeAnalyzerArtifact
inputs.label: Publish Code Analyzer reports artifact
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only applies when Code Analyzer is enabled.
